insight.commandDesc: Name drift, project health, continuity, word frequency and pacing.
insight.concordanceDistinct: {0} distinct words. The interesting ones are usually not at the top.
insight.concordanceNoHabits: Nothing used often enough across enough scenes.
insight.continuityBaseline: Recorded what every Codex entry looks like now. From here on, this lists the scenes that mention anything you change.
insight.continuityClear: Nothing has changed since you last worked through this list.
insight.continuityHint: These scenes mention something you have changed since they were last read. Whether the change matters is your call.
insight.driftHint: Each of these is spelled almost like a name in the Codex. Some will be two different names that happen to be similar.
insight.driftNone: No spellings close to a Codex name. Nothing has drifted.
insight.healthClean: Nothing to report. The project is tidy.
insight.presenceHint: Every character, and where they drop out. Gaps are counted only between a character’s first appearance and their last — arriving in chapter twenty is not an absence from the first nineteen.
insight.presenceNone: No characters in the Codex yet.
insight.statsEstimate: Page counts are estimates. The only exact page count Novalist produces is the Normseiten DOCX export, which lays the text on a fixed grid.
